control_failures.control_label: proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of electrical energy at SG-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on SG-3100 and TX-3001 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 20 September 2020 a potential incident was recorded on SG-3100 and TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
